verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HubSpot can create workflows (hubspot-docs-12/45) and describes API date-versioning (hubspot-supp-api-versioning) for endpoints, but there is no mention of versioning, review, or rollback capabilities for workflows/automations themselves (e.g., workflow history, revision comparison, undo). Missing for 10: workflow version history UI, diff/review of automation changes, rollback/restore of prior automation versions.
